extracted.name: Jerre's Black Bean and Pork Tenderloin Slow Cooker Chili
extracted.description: Tender pork and black beans stew all day in your slow cooker. Just combine the ingredients, set the cooker to low, and 8 to 10 hours later enjoy a rich and delicious chili.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 pounds pork tenderloin, cut into 2 inch strips
1 small red bell pepper, coarsely chopped
instruction_lines: Combine pork tenderloin, onion, red pepper, black beans, salsa, chicken broth, oregano, cumin, and chili powder in a slow cooker. Set to Low and cook for 8 to 10 hours.
Break up pieces of cooked pork to thicken the chili before serving.
